components.name: Filled Button
components.description: Native Compose Material 3 Button; switches to button-primary-dark with the theme. Used for vocabulary and configuration saves. Material owns shape, ripple, focus, enabled and disabled states. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Tonal Button
components.description: Native FilledTonalButton for review and saving a highlight; framework role colors, shape and interaction states. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Outlined Button
components.description: Native OutlinedButton for optional AI setup; full width in the lookup sheet. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Text Button
components.description: Native TextButton for dialog decisions, lower emphasis actions, and annotation disclosure. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Outlined Field
components.description: Native OutlinedTextField for search, settings, translation and notes. Search is single line; translation/notes allow up to four lines. API key uses password transformation and visibility control. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Adaptive Navigation
components.description: Native NavigationBar below 600dp and NavigationRail from 600dp; four labeled destinations. Hidden during reading. Component selection, ripple and focus stay Material defaults. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview. Library bottom safe-drawing insets keep its import FAB above the expanded-window taskbar.

components.name: Selection and Action Chips
components.description: Native FilterChip for filters, theme and reading font; AssistChip for explicit AI actions disabled during lookup. FlowRow wraps variable groups. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Continue Reading Card
components.description: Native clickable Card with explicit paired primary-container colors, 16dp corners, 20dp padding, 98 by 148dp cover, reading context and progress; resume-card-dark is its dark variant. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Meaning Sheet
components.description: Native fully expanded ModalBottomSheet; scrollable meanings, pronunciation, local/manual save, provenance, explicit optional AI and annotation disclosure. Native component: no HTML/CSS preview.

components.name: Reading Surface
components.description: Isolated Android WebView with theme background and foreground; bundled offline Literata or sans serif, 16–32 CSS px preference and 1.4–2.2 line height. Android fontScale drives WebView textZoom. Centered page width up to 740 CSS px. Selection opens the native meaning sheet and uses primary-container paired roles; saved highlights use secondary-container paired roles. Blockquotes use surface-container, dividers use outline-variant, and the error fallback uses current page colors. Native component: no fabricated HTML/CSS preview.

narrative.overview:
Lectio pairs graphite surfaces, slate layers, and soft blue actions with literary headings and clear native controls. Dark is the initial theme; explicit Claro and Sistema preferences remain available and persisted. Reading and contextual understanding share one space: a selected word opens a meaning sheet, while optional AI stays behind explicit actions. Local use requires no account.

This is a code-led record of the native Android Compose implementation, not a reference composition. Compose dimensions use dp and text uses sp; the isolated EPUB WebView has its own CSS reading surface. Native components in the JSON sidecar are descriptive records, not HTML/CSS previews. Token frontmatter is normative; framework defaults remain owned by Material 3, and implementation limitations below are not new design rules.
keyCharacteristics: Modern graphite dark surfaces, slate containers, soft blue actions, and a cool light scheme.
Serif literary headings with sans serif functional text.
Material 3 controls, tonal containers, and native modal sheets.
Adjustable reading type and contextual meanings with visible provenance.
Four destinations that adapt from bottom navigation to a rail.

rules.name: The Paired Roles Rule
rules.body: Resolve UI colors through `MaterialTheme.colorScheme` and use the foreground role corresponding to its background role.

rules.name: The Two Reading Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the Compose type roles for app UI; allow the separate reading page to follow the reader's serif/sans, size, and line-height preferences.

rules.name: The Navigation Width Rule
rules.body: Use the existing compact bar / expanded rail boundary; do not copy the compact bar onto the expanded layout.

dos: Do use Material 3 color roles with matching foregrounds in both explicit schemes.
Do use serif headline roles and sans serif functional type through `LectioTypography`.
Do retain the compact navigation bar and expanded navigation rail behavior.
Do keep reading preferences separate from app UI typography.
Do preserve visible meaning provenance and explicit optional AI actions in the reading context.
Do use native Material controls and their built-in interaction states.
donts: Don't treat fallback cover colors as general app accents or reintroduce fixed warm colors into themed reader content.
Don't promote tiny uppercase cover labels into a reusable heading pattern.
Don't describe framework defaults as custom Lectio shadow, shape, motion, or error tokens.
Don't introduce account UI as a prerequisite to local reading or vocabulary.
Don't present Android 15 emulator captures or DOM selection tests as physical-phone gesture, TTS, or performance verification.
